description: Use after enhance_prompt, once you know what the prompt is about. Returns the full checklist for that domain: must-haves, each item with an example question and its recommended (★) default, and a worked example. Domains: coding (code, agents, tool instructions), writing (copy, marketing, emails, posts, stories), research (research, analysis, comparisons, data), image-video (image or video generation; includes each tool's syntax), general (anything else, including system prompts and custom-assistant instructions).
